import bpy, os, json, pathlib, subprocess
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
parent=bpy.data.collections.get('01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4'); low=bpy.data.collections.get('D | ESTACAO CIDADE BAIXA | blockout v1')
if not parent or not low: raise RuntimeError('colecoes do Elevador ausentes')
# candidatos reais de contato com rua/praca
objs=[]
for o in parent.objects:
    n=o.name.lower()
    if any(k in n for k in ['porta entrada','fachada terreo','marquise entrada']): objs.append(('UP',o))
for o in low.objects:
    n=o.name.lower()
    if any(k in n for k in ['porta','acesso','fachada','entrada','piso saguao']): objs.append(('LOW',o))
rows=[]
for zone,o in objs:
    # ponto de contato usa o menor Z do bbox, mais representativo que origem do objeto
    if hasattr(o,'bound_box') and o.type=='MESH':
        pts=[o.matrix_world @ __import__('mathutils').Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]; zmin=min(p.z for p in pts)
    else: zmin=o.location.z
    rows.append({'zone':zone,'name':o.name,'x':float(o.location.x),'y':float(o.location.y),'contact_z':float(zmin),'origin_z':float(o.location.z)})
print('CANDIDATES='+json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False))
work=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work'); py=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo\Scripts\python.exe'
script=work/'sample_entrance_contacts.py'
script.write_text(r'''
import numpy as np,json,sys
d=np.load(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work\terrain_2017_candidate.npz'); pts=d['verts'].reshape(-1,3); rows=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
for q in rows:
 dd=(pts[:,0]-q['x'])**2+(pts[:,1]-q['y'])**2; i=int(np.argmin(dd)); p=pts[i]
 print(q['zone'],'|',q['name'],'| CONTACT_Z',round(q['contact_z'],3),'| TERRAIN_Z',round(float(p[2]),3),'| DZ',round(q['contact_z']-float(p[2]),3),'| XY_DIST',round(float(dd[i]**0.5),3))
''',encoding='utf-8')
r=subprocess.run([py,str(script),json.dumps(rows)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr)
if r.returncode: raise RuntimeError('falha na amostragem de contatos')
print('ENTRANCE_TERRAIN_CONTACT_CHECK_OK')
